grounding.from: Research notes: Denver, Colorado, forecast for Tuesday, October 13, 2026 (tomorrow, given today is Monday, Oct 12).

grounding.states: Cooler than Monday, partly sunny, with clouds and a chance of showers late in the day
grounding.from: Tomorrow looks cooler, with clouds and a chance of showers late in the day. The Denver Gazette (NWS Boulder forecast) says partly sunny skies Tuesday, with rain and showers possibly moving in Tuesday evening.

grounding.states: High around 65°F, about 15 degrees cooler than Monday's 80
grounding.from: The NWS forecast high is 65°F. That is roughly 15 degrees cooler than Monday's high of 80. Other sources give similar highs.

grounding.states: Overnight low in the low 30s to low 40s Tuesday night
grounding.from: Lows are expected in the low 40s and 30s Tuesday night (NWS via Denver Gazette). KDVR also says lows in the lower 40s.

grounding.states: About 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m., rising into the evening
grounding.from: NWS gives a 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m. The chances increase into the evening.

grounding.states: North-northeast winds 6 to 10 mph, turning east to northeast in the afternoon, gusts up to 17 mph
grounding.from: Wind: North-northeast winds of 6 to 10 mph, turning east to northeast in the afternoon with gusts up to 17 mph.

value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver is cooler. High around 65°F, partly sunny, then clouds and a chance of showers late in the afternoon into the evening (about 30%). Lows drop to the low 30s to low 40s overnight, and there's a breeze from the northeast, gusts up to 17 mph. Grab a jacket.
